description: Single storey side extension; installation of front drive gates
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted, including its colour, pointing/bonding shall match those used on the external surfaces of existing building.

The flat roofed area of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

<p>The
development already carried, hereby permitted in accordance with the following
approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Location Plan
entitled Planning Portal Reference: PP-12859672v1;</li><li>Amended
Existing and Proposed Site Block Plan entitled Drawing No: 5885- PL100 Rev B;</li><li>Existing
Lower, Ground, First and Roof Floor Plans entitled Drawing No: 5885 PL104;</li><li>Proposed Ground
Floor and Roof Plans entitled Drawing No: 5885 PL102 Rev C;</li><li>Existing
Elevations Plan entitled Drawing No: 5885 PL105;</li><li>Amened
Proposed Elevations Plan entitled Drawing No: 5885 PL103 Rev B;</li><li>Amended
Proposed Front Hedge line and Gates Plan entitled Drawing No: 5885- PL101 Rev
B;</li><li>Heritage
Statement Ref: 2205.1060 dated March 1st, 2025;</li><li>Reasonable
Exception Statement received March 5th, 2025;</li></ul>

The design of
the front entrance gates hereby permitted, shall be of a five-bar design as depicted
on approved plans list, amened drawings entitled Proposed Elevations Plan
entitled Drawing No: 5885 PL103 Rev B and Proposed Front Hedge line and Gates
Plan entitled Drawing No: 5885- PL101 Rev B;
